PUB-noregress-temp.question: What is the operating temperature range of NE301 edge camera

sources.title: NE301 Edge AI Camera Outdoor Deploying Guide:  Power, Connectivity, and Fleet Management

PUB-noregress-temp.answer:
**Operating Temperature Range**

The NE301 is rated for **−20°C to +50°C**, covering freezer environments (−18°C), refrigerated cabinets (2°C–8°C), and extreme outdoor deployments. [1][2][4][5]

**Low-Temperature Note**

Battery capacity decreases at low temperatures — at −20°C, effective alkaline AA capacity drops approximately 25–35% compared to room temperature. For cold-climate deployments, CamThink recommends lithium AA cells, which retain ~85–90% capacity at −20°C. [1][5]

PUB-noregress-power.answer:
无法从已检索资料中确认 NE101 支持 12V 电源适配器供电。

**供电方式**
资料中明确提到的 NE101 供电方式为电池供电,未提及 12V DC 适配器供电。[1][7][10]

**其他产品对照**
资料中提及支持有线供电的为 NE301 PoE 变体(802.3af/at,单根网线供电),该说明不适用于 NE101。[8]

如需确认供电兼容性,建议参考 NE101 产品页或 CamThink 提供的电池寿命计算器,按实际捕获频率和连接方式估算电池配置。[10]
